frustum

frustum, frustī n.

noun, second declension

piece or chunk

In this lexicon

  • piece

    the recommended word · classical

  • frustum būbulae: steak

    modern

Notes

  1. 1frustum: short u (Traupman frūstum, pp. 72, 360). A different word from frūstrā, “in vain”, whose u is long; Traupman himself prints frustum on pp. 282 and 336. Ruling: frūstrā with a long u.

Examples

  • Parvum frustum cape.

    Take a small piece.composed

    In the entry for piece
